title: Google Business Profile Checklist for Rockford-Area Businesses

cover.alt: A conceptual brick storefront on an abstract map is surrounded by a location pin, photo cards and a clock.

figures.title: Keep customer-facing details consistent
figures.summary: The information review starts with facts customers use to find and contact the business.

items.label: Name
items.detail: Use the business name customers recognize from signage and the website.

items.label: Contact
items.detail: Check the primary phone number against the website and directory listings.

items.label: Location
items.detail: Represent the real location and service area accurately.

items.label: Hours
items.detail: Keep opening information aligned with actual availability.

items.label: Category
items.detail: Choose a category that describes the work the business really performs.

figures.caption: A factual information checklist from the article, not a ranking guarantee or a statement of current verification options.

figures.title: A useful profile needs upkeep
figures.summary: These maintenance areas help keep the business information useful to customers.

items.label: Photos
items.detail: Show the real exterior, workspace, team or completed work.

items.label: Reviews
items.detail: Read customer feedback and respond professionally.

items.label: Updates
items.detail: Review announcements and offers for continuing accuracy.

items.label: Service details
items.detail: Revisit the services and areas described when the business changes.

figures.caption: Ongoing content checks drawn from the article. Features available in the business account should be confirmed before use.
